title: SMS vs. Email Marketing — Which is Better for Your Business?

facts.fact: Kixie's article cites SimpleTexting's finding that in 2022, 57% of business owners said the number of their prospects and customers who opted in to receive SMS messages had increased compared with 2021.
facts.quote: In 2022, 57% of business owners say the number of their prospects and customers who have opted-in to receive SMS messages has increased, as compared to 2021.

facts.fact: Kixie's article states that over 60% of consumers want the ability to text a business back and have a two-way conversation instead of only an auto-reply.
facts.quote: Over 60% of consumers also want the ability to text a business back, and have a two-way conversation instead of just an auto-reply.
